component.name: Windsurf
component.summary: AI-powered IDE that keeps you in flow.

description.p: Windsurf is an AI-powered IDE that understands your codebase, assists with complex tasks, and helps you stay in flow.
This is an unofficially packaged application, flatpak version is based on VScodium. It is not supported by Codeium/Windsurf team.
IMPORTANT: flatpak version of Windsurf is not straightforward to use. Stick to native packages if you are not confident in linux and/or value simplicity.
For more information, see [README](https://github.com/stone-w4tch3r/com.windsurf.ide) and [VScodium repo and docs](https://github.com/flathub/com.vscodium.codium/)
